  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Checks whether a login name is available.

Login names are unique across SFTP To Go, not just your organization. Reserved names such as
`admin`, `root` and `support` are always reported as taken. If you use one anyway, a name in use
returns `422` and a reserved name returns `400`.

This call creates nothing. It's a `POST` so that the name stays out of URLs and logs.
